note: One numeric tripwire, generously set: source `!important` must stay <= 50 (currently 22). It exists to catch a campaign-scale regression, not to police normal work — raise it deliberately if a legitimate override needs the room, and never tighten it toward the current count. Everything else — source/dist bytes, literal hex/rgba, color-mix with literal color, px font sizes, dead CSS — is printed by `npm run css:audit` as a REPORT, never a ceiling: the 2026-10 reduction campaign is closed and its numbers were a snapshot of that baseline. `importOrder` is the canonical src/index.css partial order (type-scale.css last).
